items.name: Starvation lowers tonic dopamine
items.metric: mean extracellular DA, awake ticks of day 3
items.mechanism: blood amino acids (tyrosine) x brain fuel (K-ATP) gate VTA firing and DA synthesis

items.name: Starvation lowers exploration
items.metric: choice entropy (bits), 80 probe choices on a standardised value map
items.mechanism: DA sets striatal noise amplitude in the spiking race

items.name: DA mediates the starvation effect (clamp rescues exploration)
items.mechanism: starved + DA clamped at 0.25 vs starved

items.name: Sleep deprivation degrades memory-guided choice
items.metric: expected reward of 80 probe choices on trained sites (day 4, 08:00)
items.mechanism: NREM replay consolidates hippocampal episodes into site-value synapses; adenosine adds decision noise

items.name: REM recombination dreams improve later choice among novel sites
items.metric: expected reward of 80 probe choices restricted to the 8 never-visited sites
items.mechanism: REM pairs colour of one memory with shape of another and writes the cortical feature-model prediction into the novel site's value

items.name: Vagotomy (gut-brain axis lesion) blunts post-meal satiety
items.metric: forage attempts 2 h before minus 2 h after a 20 kJ meal
items.mechanism: gut fill + ENS activity -> vagal afferent -> hypothalamic satiety neurons

items.name: Locus coeruleus stimulation drives heart rate through the sympathetic chain
items.metric: HR change (bpm), 30 min stim vs preceding hour
items.mechanism: LC rate -> sympathetic tone -> HR -> brain perfusion

items.name: SCN lesion flattens the sleep-wake rhythm
items.metric: night sleep fraction minus day sleep fraction (days 2-4)
items.mechanism: SCN oscillator (light-entrained) supplies process C and melatonin

items.name: Thought curvature is felt: high-curvature moments raise LC (noradrenergic) firing
items.metric: LC rate at t+1 when kappa(t) above median minus below (awake, day 2)
items.mechanism: trajectory curvature of the latent neural state -> insula -> LC

items.name: Higher intelligence level costs more brain ATP
items.mechanism: level sets deliberation substeps and per-spike cost

items.name: Higher intelligence level improves choice
items.metric: probe expected reward (day 4 08:00, level switched just before the probe)
items.mechanism: more integration steps average out decision noise

items.name: Quantum noise source vs classical (equivalence, preregistered expectation |d|<0.5)
items.mechanism: Born-rule sampled 3-qubit state vs classical coin

items.name: Energy conservation across every run of this suite
items.mechanism: explicit flux ledger: gut, blood, liver, fat, muscle, brain, ATP, heat, excreta
items.note: max error 0.00e+0 over 464 runs; leaky control min 2.49e-3

items.name: Seeded determinism
items.mechanism: pure seeded RNG; crypto entropy only when explicitly requested
items.note: same-seed identical: true; different seeds differ: true
